reviews.body: Nice touch with the idempotency key.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: The first commit added `transfer_status` with `requests.get(...)`. Same story as #113 and ADR-006: everything goes through the module's `_client`. requests isn't even in our dependencies anymore; it only worked because some dev dependency pulls it in.

comments.author: dan
comments.body: Ugh, copied from the bank's sample code. Fixed to use `_client`.

comments.author: frank
comments.body: Each resubmission should be wrapped in a retry with exponential backoff; banks are flaky and one attempt per night is too few.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: The shared client already retries transient errors on every call, and this job *is* the slow outer retry. Adding a backoff loop per payout is how INC-12 happened. One retry layer in the client, plus the nightly job for anything that's still failing.

threads.rejection_reason: make_client already retries; the nightly job is the outer retry. Extra loops caused INC-12.
